It's never the rent that breaks your budget — it's the MOT, the school shoes, and December. 🌿

Those bills aren't monthly, but they're guaranteed. A sinking fund is how you stop them ambushing you: pick the bill, divide it by the months left, and save that bit every month into a named pot.

The 8 funds people forget:
• The car — MOT, service, tyres
• Christmas
• Birthdays & gifts
• Holidays & days out
• School costs — uniform, shoes, trips
• Home repairs — boiler, washer, roof
• Annual renewals — insurance, subscriptions
• The vet

Example: £240 for Christmas ÷ 5 paydays left = £48 a month. Small now beats painful later.
